title: 42 CFR 411.351: Definitions (physician self-referral), including fair market value, general market value and isolated financial transaction
note: Fair market value is the value in an arm's-length transaction consistent with general market value. An isolated financial transaction paid in installments needs the total fixed before the first payment. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-06.

title: 42 CFR 424.516: Additional provider and supplier requirements for enrolling and maintaining active enrollment status in the Medicare program
note: Paragraph (d): physicians and practitioners report a change of ownership, adverse legal action or practice location change within 30 days and all other changes within 90 days. Paragraph (f): keep documentation of orders, certifications and referrals 7 years. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-06.

title: 42 CFR 424.520: Effective date of Medicare billing privileges
note: For physicians, practitioners and their organizations the effective date is the later of the filing date of an application later approved or the date services began at a new location. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-06.

title: 42 CFR 424.521: Request for payment by certain provider and supplier types
note: Retrospective billing up to 30 days before the effective date if circumstances precluded earlier enrollment, 90 days in a declared disaster. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-06.

title: 42 CFR 424.526: Return of a provider's or supplier's enrollment application
note: An application received more than 60 days before the effective date listed may be returned, as may a change-of-ownership application filed more than 90 days before the sale. No appeal rights. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-06.

title: 42 CFR 424.540: Deactivation of Medicare billing privileges
note: Billing privileges may be deactivated after 6 consecutive calendar months with no claims, for unreported changes, or on voluntary withdrawal. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-06.

title: 42 CFR 424.510: Requirements for enrolling in the Medicare program
note: Enrollees must agree to receive payment by electronic funds transfer and submit Form CMS-588. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-06.

title: 42 CFR 424.80: Prohibition of reassignment of claims by suppliers (with 42 CFR 424.73 on billing agents)
note: Medicare does not pay amounts due a supplier to another person under reassignment or power of attorney, except an employer, a contracting enrolled entity or a billing agent that meets the 424.73(b)(3) conditions. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-06.

title: 42 CFR 483.70: Administration (requirements for long-term care facilities)
note: Paragraph (g): the facility must designate a physician to serve as medical director. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-06.

title: 42 CFR 422.504: Contract provisions (Medicare Advantage)
note: Plans keep records 10 years and must require contracted providers to accept federal audit rights for 10 years from the end of the contract period (paragraphs (d) and (i)(2)). Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-06.

title: 42 CFR 422.202: Participation procedures (Medicare Advantage)
note: Paragraph (d)(4): a plan and a contracting provider must give each other at least 60 days' written notice before terminating without cause. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-06.

title: 45 CFR 164.501: Definitions (HIPAA Privacy Rule), health care operations
note: Health care operations include the sale, transfer or merger of a covered entity with another covered entity and related due diligence. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-05.

title: 45 CFR 164.502: Uses and disclosures of protected health information: general rules
note: The ban on selling protected health information does not cover a sale or merger of the practice and related due diligence. The minimum necessary standard applies. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-05.

title: 45 CFR 164.316: Policies and procedures and documentation requirements (HIPAA Security Rule)
note: Six-year retention applies to security policies and required documentation, not to medical records. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-05.

title: 45 CFR 162.410: Implementation specifications: Health care providers (National Provider Identifier)
note: Providers must report changes in their National Provider Identifier data within 30 days. Text read through the eCFR API, version dated 2026-11-05.

title: Florida Administrative Code 64B8-10.001: Medical Records of Deceased Physician; Retention, Time Limitations
publisher: Florida Department of State (Board of Medicine rule)
note: The executor keeps records at least two years after the physician's death and publishes notice within one month. Physicians must make sure the executor can access paper and electronic records, including passwords.

publisher: Florida Department of State (Board of Osteopathic Medicine rule)
note: On voluntary termination, publish a newspaper notice, post an office sign 30 days before closing, and provide for record retention at least two years after the practice ends.
